name: Elbows Back
instructions: Place both hands on your lower back, fingers pointing downward and elbows out.
Then gently pull your elbows back aiming to touch them together.
prompt: This is a Elbows Back for stretching that uses static force to primarily train the chest. These are the instructions that a person would receive: "Stand up straight. Place both hands on your lower back, fingers pointing downward and elbows out. Then gently pull your elbows back aiming to touch them together."
